title: Marketplace Approval
description: Vendor approval for a plugin marketplace file. Every plugin the marketplace file lists is fanned out into its own registry plugin entry during consolidation, re-resolved on every run.

source.description: Location and format of the marketplace file

url.description: Git repository URL hosting the marketplace file

format.description: Which marketplace file format to parse. "codex" is OpenAI Codex/ChatGPT's .agents/plugins/marketplace.json format.

path.description: Path within the repository to the marketplace file. Omit to use the format's conventional path (.agents/plugins/marketplace.json for "codex").
